name: Droid chef
description: Droid chefs was a type of cooking droid found in the galaxy. During 3 ABY, droid chef operated street food stalls on the planets Akiva, Kijimi, and Tatooine, as well as the moon Toshara; serving Kurado fruit platter, Duradan Soup, Sketto Chuga and Che Mosskà respectively.
